question: Two different inductors, A and B, have their Inductive Reactance ($X_L$) plotted against angular frequency ($\omega$). The slope of line A is steeper (greater) than the slope of line B. What does this comparison indicate about the physical properties of the two inductors?

options.A: Inductor A has a higher self-inductance ($L$) than Inductor B.
options.B: Inductor A has a lower self-inductance ($L$) than Inductor B.
options.C: Inductor A has higher resistance than Inductor B.
options.D: Inductor A allows more AC current to flow than Inductor B for the same voltage.
